newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly up in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly up in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed up 0.15 percent in higher trade on Friday, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 456.77 points, up from 456.08 on Thursday.
Total volume was 939,466 dinars against 407,872 dinars over the previous session.

Amen Bank won 0.9 dinar to 31.8 dinars. Amen Bank made 7.93 million dinars post-tax net profit in 1996 from 7.24 million in 1995 and announced that it will distribute a five percent ordinary dividend and an additional five percent super dividend.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie bank was up 0.58 dinar to 29.2.
Airline Tunis Air rose 0.5 dinar to 23.2 dinars with 4,855 shares changing hands. Milk firm Tunisie Lait advanced 0.3 dinar to 22.3.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT was down 0.5 dinar to 81 dinars. Detergents firm SPCD eased 0.38 dinar to 28.5 dinars.
